title: IVG Smart Max Blueberry Peach Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: The Blueberry Peach IVG Smart Max Prefilled Pod combines two popular fruit flavours in a smooth, well-rounded vape. Sweet, jammy Blueberry pairs with the light, juicy taste of Peach for a blend that balances depth and freshness from inhale to exhale. Each pack includes a 2ml pod prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, along with a 10ml refill reservoir that automatically tops up the pod as you vape. This smart system is designed to support up to 12,000 puffs per kit depending on use, removing the need for manual refilling or coil changes. Fitted with mesh coil technology, the pod ensures rich flavour and consistent vapour all day long. Designed exclusively for use with the IVG Smart Max 12K Prefilled Pod Vape Kit, installation is quick and simple — just click the pod into place and start vaping. How to Set Up: Remove the red stoppers from the 2ml pod. Twist and remove the red safety cap from the 10ml refill reservoir. Insert the pod into the refill and press firmly until they click together. Insert the connected pod and refill into the Smart Max device.
